createIntro: Pick some dates, add the people you want to ask, and share their personal link. Each participant answers whether they prefer, can, or can't make it.
modeAssignedHint: You add each person and share their personal link.
modeOpenHint: One shared link. Anyone who opens it enters their own name and answer.
choicesHint: "Can make it" and "Can't make it" are always included.
shareLinkHint: Anyone with this link can add their name and answer.
editLinkHint: Save this to change your answer later.
datesHint: Add at least one date. Times are optional.
calendarEmptyHint: No dates picked yet — click the calendar above.
participantsHint: Give each participant a name, then copy their link and send it to them.
name: Name
errorEndNeedsStart: Set a start time before adding an end time
errorEndBeforeStart: End time can't be before the start time
responseIntro: Choose the dates that suit you best
datesQuestion: How do these dates suit you?
savedSub: You can change your answer until the poll closes.
linkNotFoundSub: Check that you copied the whole link, or ask the organizer to send it again.
chooseEach: Choose an option for each date
organizerLinkWarning: This is your only way back to the poll and its results. Bookmark it. It can't be recovered if you lose it. Don't share it with the participants.
closeSelectHint: Pick the final date(s) below, then confirm.
confirmCancelPoll: Close the poll without choosing a date? Participants will see it as cancelled.
errorNoSelection: Choose at least one date to close the poll
cancelledMessage: The organizer cancelled this poll. No date was chosen.
confirmDeleteOption: This date has answers. Delete it anyway?
confirmDeleteInvitee: This participant has answered. Remove them anyway? Their link will stop working.
newDatesBanner: New dates have been added since you answered. Please update your answer.
needsUpdateTitle: Some participants haven't answered the new dates
needsUpdateHint: Send them their personal link again so they can answer the new dates.
